summary: Requested execution that measures the configuration-change proposal gate the earlier refutation rested on. A live leader accepts an AddNode for node 4 and then, before that change is committed or applied, receives an AddNode for node 5; the saved entry types and the dropped-entry report of both updates are the endpoints. Local construction runs showed one configuration-change entry saved for the first proposal, none for the second, one plain application entry in its place and one dropped entry keyed 9002. Validation reports valid with execution_requested and one experiment create; recording the fact and revising that interpretation awaits the receipt.
